curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when intergalactic travelers travel across the cosmos only to develop an obsession with rustic farm cooking?
curatedMovie.description: In Jean Girault's French sci-fi comedy, two rural buddy farmers find their quiet routines upended when extraterrestrial visitors drop by with a surprising craving for their homemade cabbage soup.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, playful, and easy to watch, offering broad comic warmth and steady pacing ideal for a casual night with friends.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Blending classic French farce with playful science fiction, this lighthearted collision of countryside domesticity and flying saucers delivers an offbeat, easy-going laugh.
